author: Dan; implementation by Codex
selection: Highest feasible grid count within the existing setup constraints, then rank candidates by crossing-rate proxy times minimum actual modeled cash net per grid. Cost-aware entry/replacement gates, 2400-USDT total capital and existing support/resistance range selection remain. This does not claim global grid-count optimality or guaranteed income.
volatility_candidate: 100*(24h_high-24h_low)/24h_low; NOT verified as KuCoin UI definition
execution_limits: No runtime, installed scheduler, order API or live recommendations.
OHLC-generated fill ledgers are simulations, not observed KuCoin trades.
Snapshot calibration cannot recover unknown original quantities or margin amendments; never fit each symbol to its target.
Both continuous and gap-aware price paths are disclosed; any liquidation fails the trial.
Missing historical books, funding, membership or candles stays explicit coverage failure.
Stop-loss closes automatically; no qualifying replacement means remain closed, not resurrect a stopped bot.
Baseline actual margins plus reserve are reported separately from the 2400-USDT two-bot portfolio.
Dan separately authorized read-only signed-in Chrome observation gathering; no order submissions or account-credential handling.
The earlier +1-USDT / 5%-1% outcomes are archived references and do not validate this amended policy.
Positive completed-grid income is distinct from total net after floating losses, funding and closing costs.
No live bot changes or deployment. A fresh 48-hour paper clock remains unstarted until an actual matching paper-run event.
neutral_evidence: RAY: 70 grids, 140 orders, long 544 lots and short 629 lots, 17 lots per order, used 1000 plus 200 reserve; preview and post-creation states remain separate.
minimum_grid_rule: Every planned adjacent cycle must produce strictly positive base-quantity cash PnL after both 0.06% fill fees and tick/lot rounding; exact break-even fails. No arbitrary positive USDT floor. Nominal margin/grids and percentage previews are display-only.
range_exit_policy: Close all paper inventory at market when price reaches or crosses either low or high, regardless of direction. Stop priority cancels an order at the same edge. No 5% wait or 1% fallback. A gap executes at the observed quote and can still cause liquidation before a solvent close.
range_selection: Causal seven-day structure, confirmed five-bar swing pivots (two closed bars on each side), ATR clipping; show supporting levels, touch counts and fallback evidence.
amendment: Dan removed the fixed +1-USDT floor and explicitly confirmed: when range is hit we out. This paper policy requires strictly positive planned cash after both fill fees and closes at either exact range edge.

evaluation.start_event: paper_run_started with fresh first observation and matching sealed source/policy
evaluation.previous_results: preserved separately; never relabeled as this strategy

coverage.indicator_gaps: causal previous-close forward fill; no future seed
coverage.crossing_gaps: exclude synthetic minutes and crossings bridging gaps

historical_assumptions: Derive quote turnover from candle contract volume times contract multiplier times close; approximate not observed quote turnover.
Skip spread, depth and funding-window admission checks only in explicitly labeled candle-only filters mode.
Static contract metadata from the copied capture is a retrospective assumption, with survivorship and contract-change limitations.
Unknown funding is not measured zero; report modeled zero separately and block verified net/continuation.
Ten basis points full modeled spread when historical quotes are unavailable; retain actual quotes where available.
Missing minute extrema and intraminute OHLC order remain execution uncertainty.
Existing uncalibrated sizing may be used only for labeled sensitivity results pending independently observed quantities.

calibration.required: Independent original form inputs, actual order quantities and amendment history must identify allocation across modes; fee-net cash arithmetic alone cannot validate quantity prediction or liquidation parity.
calibration.forbidden: Inferring quantities from target profits and claiming independent prediction.
calibration.observations: Six redacted actual order configurations plus separately labeled unsubmitted Long/Short/Neutral previews. Actual quantity-based cash accounting passes; universal allocation remains unverified.
